artifact_review: The Router correctly identified severe structural issues. The 'structural_collapse' at the bottom edge (Severity 4) is confirmed by visual inspection; the device literally dissolves into noise. The 'text_gibberish' (Severity 3) is strongly supported by the Image Text Auditor returning empty results despite visible markings. The 'texture_anomaly' in the background (Severity 3) is also valid. The Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence score (0.97) is misleading here; it likely segmented the main coherent block of the radio but failed to capture the melting boundary accurately, or the mask provided is just the bounding box interior. I disagree with the Perceptual Quality Auditor's 'null' finding; it missed the significant text and structural artifacts because it focuses on global noise/blur, not semantic coherence. The Router's severity ratings are appropriate.
